label: Wildfire risk
unit: FEMA NRI wildfire risk index score (0-100, higher is riskier)
description: FEMA National Risk Index wildfire Risk Index score (expected annual loss scaled by social vulnerability and community resilience, national percentile 0-100), averaged over the census tracts inside the town weighted by population. Tracts are assigned to a town when the tract centroid is inside the UGRC municipal outline; moab, richfield, kanab, ephraim had no tract centroid inside and take the tract containing the town center. Measured, not estimated, for all 42 towns.
source: FEMA National Risk Index, census tract layer (Wildfire, WFIR_RISKS)
